text:
Hide me, so the world will not guess me.
Hide me as the trunk hides its resin, and
let me perfume you in the shade, like
a drop of gum; let me soften you with
it, so the others will not know where
your sweetness comes from…


I am ugly without you, like things torn
from their place; like roots abandoned
on the ground.


Why am I not small as an almond
inside its closed shell?


Drink me! Make me a drop of your blood,
and I will rise to your cheek and live there
like the vivid speck on a grape leaf.
Make me your sigh, and I will rise
and fall from your chest, wind myself
around your heart, go out into the air and return.
And I will play this game
all my life.

translation.title: Hide Me
